source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: Whenever an enemy unit (other than TITANIC units) that is in Engagement Range of at least one unit with this ability is picked to fight, melee attacks by its models get -1 to their Hit rolls for the rest of the phase.

trigger.enemyWithinEngagementRangeOf: one or more units with this ability

effect.attacks: melee attacks by models in that enemy unit
